add-subtract-100-skill-01.target: I can add two-digit numbers within 100 using place value, and make a new ten when the ones add to 10 or more.
add-subtract-100-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can add two-digit numbers within 100 using place value, and make a new ten when the ones add to 10 or more.
add-subtract-100-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Not making a ten from 10 or more ones (47 + 35 → 712), or adding the tens digits as ones. Try this: Add tens and tens, ones and ones on a place-value mat; trade ten ones for a ten before writing the sum.

add-subtract-100-skill-02.target: I can subtract within 100 using place value, breaking apart a ten when there are not enough ones.
add-subtract-100-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can subtract within 100 using place value, breaking apart a ten when there are not enough ones.
add-subtract-100-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Subtracting the smaller digit from the larger digit in each place (52 − 27 → 35). Try this: Model with blocks: if there are not enough ones, trade one ten for ten ones first.

add-subtract-100-skill-03.target: I can use addition to check subtraction and to find an unknown number within 100.
add-subtract-100-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can use addition to check subtraction and to find an unknown number within 100.
add-subtract-100-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Checking 63 − 28 = 35 by subtracting again instead of adding 35 + 28. Try this: Show both on one part-part-whole diagram: the parts add to the whole.

add-subtract-100-skill-04.skill: Adding Three or Four Two-Digit Numbers
add-subtract-100-skill-04.target: I can add up to four two-digit numbers by adding tens and ones or by finding friendly pairs.
add-subtract-100-skill-04.ifCorrect: You can do this: can add up to four two-digit numbers by adding tens and ones or by finding friendly pairs.
add-subtract-100-skill-04.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Losing an addend, or forgetting the new tens when the ones add to 20 or more. Try this: Cross off each addend as it is used; add all the tens, then all the ones, then combine.

add-subtract-100-skill-05.target: I can explain why a strategy works using place value and properties of operations.
add-subtract-100-skill-05.ifCorrect: You can do this: can explain why a strategy works using place value and properties of operations.
add-subtract-100-skill-05.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Saying a strategy works “because the answer is right” without naming tens and ones, or thinking order matters in addition. Try this: Use sentence frames: “I broke ___ into ___ tens and ___ ones because …”; compare two strategies side by side.
